message:
You know, I’ve always fancied myself a bit of a Boy Scout—always prepared for whatever Mother Nature decides to throw my way. With storms rolling in more often than I can count, it’s nice to know there’s a reliable resource out there to help navigate the heat that sometimes follows. I mean, who doesn’t want to be the gloriously over-prepared person in the neighborhood? 

Just think of all the cool drinks and popsicles you can have at the ready while everyone else is sweating it out! So, what’s your go-to tip for staying cool during a stormy spell? 🥤
